Mini N vs The Vadakara Municipality on 22 November, 2024
Wp(C) No. 41015 Of 2024 1 2024:Ker:87730
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam 
 Present
 The Honourable Mr.Justice Mohammed Nias C.P.
Friday, The 22nd Day Of November 2024 / 1St Agrahayana, 1946 
 Wp(C) No. 41015 Of 2024
Petitioner:
 Mini N., Aged 39 Years,
 W/O Sreeyesh N C, Sree Sadanam,
 Poovadan Gate, Vadakara, Vadakara Beach,
 Kozhikode, Kerala, Pin - 673103
 By Adv K.Reeha Khader 
RESPONDENTS:
 1 THE VADAKARA MUNICIPALITY,
 REP. BY ITS SECRETARY, PERINGADI VAYALIL,
 VATAKARA, KERALA, PIN - 673101  2 THE SECRETARY,
 VADAKARA MUNICIPALITY, PERINGADI VAYALIL,
 VATAKARA, KERALA, PIN - 673101  SRI.T.NAVEEN, SC  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD ON 22.11.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C) NO. 41015 OF 2024 2 2024:KER:87730  JUDGMENT The prayers in the writ petition are as follows:
"i. Issue a writ of Certiorari and quashing the Exhibit P2 notice issued by the 2nd respondent. 
Mini N vs The Vadakara Municipality on 22 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121824948/
1 ii. Issue a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to re-inspect the said building and verify whether the unlawful construction is still existed or not. iii. Dispense with the filing of the English translation of the vernacular documents as the petitioner undertakes to produce the same as and when directed by this Hon'ble Court.
iv. Such other relief which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper. 
v. The petitioner may be granted cost of the litigation." 
2. The petitioner has been served with Ext.P4 stop memo on 26.10.2024. The petitioner submits that no reply has been given to him so far. Accordingly, there will be a direction to the petitioner to file their objections to Ext.P4 within a week from WP(C) NO. 41015 OF 2024 3 2024:KER:87730 today and a consequential direction to the respondents to consider the objections within a week thereafter and pass appropriate orders on the same. 
The writ petition is disposed of as above. 
Sd/-
MOHAMMED NIAS C.P. JUDGE DMR/-

Exhibit P2 A TRUE COPY OF THE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE COMMISSIONERATE OF FOOD SAFETY UNDER GOVT. OF KERALA DATED 27.02.2024. Exhibit P3 A TRUE COPY OF THE UDYAM REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE OF THE FLOUR MILL DATED 09.05.2022. 
Exhibit P4 A TRUE COPY OF THE THE PROVISIONAL ORDER ISSUED BY THE 2ND RESPONDENT U/S 406(1) (2) OF KERALA MUNICIPALITY ACT, 1994 DATED 26-10-2024.
